name: ai-agent-git-routing
description: Codex routing context for fast handoff-backed simple git workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Start git-commit routing and git preflight concurrently.
interface.longDescription: AI Agent Git Routing registers UserPromptSubmit context for simple branch, commit, push, and PR workflows so Codex starts spawn discovery/launch and a fixed read-only Git Context Pack concurrently, prefers the git-commit role when callable, and falls back to main-session execution when no spawn route exists.
defaultPrompt: Start git-commit routing and the fixed Git Context Pack concurrently for simple git workflows.
